title: Multiplication column sum
statement: For Boolean lists $a,b$ and a natural-number column index $j$, define the column sum to be the sum over positions $p$ in the range from $0$ to $|a|-1$ of $a_p b_{j-p}$ when $p\le j$, and $0$ otherwise; list entries beyond either list's length are interpreted as false, and each Boolean is identified with $0$ or $1$.
